title: Joey Son NDE 978
content: My son went into insulin shock while sleeping and woke up trying to speak but he couldn't. He said afterward, he was invisible and could see himself, my wife, and me as we tried to help him. This has happened twice while he was sleeping and he always says the same thing. That he could see himself. Well the first time he said he saw a monster barking at him but that was exactly the sound he was making during his fit. My son is very closed mouth about what happened to him and will not describe it any further than to say he goes invisible. When I asked him if he could see himself he said, 'Yes.'

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Insulin shock Life threatening event, but not clinical death My son went into Insulin shock while sleeping. He woke up trying to speak and could not do anything but make something like a barking sound.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes My son described himself as being invisible as he was watching himself have seizures.
